summary: No use of the reserved cohort for fitting, acquisition, calibration, or assessment prior to its designated sensitivity evaluation was found in the inspected, retained project records.
scope: The ACDC training-release same-source reserve defined by the seed-2026 patient protocol. The official 50-patient ACDC assessment and PRCV are separate from this claim.
cache_loading: All 20 reserved cases were present in the 100-case source cache in both archives. Legacy code could load the shared cache prior to forming role-specific inputs. The audit tracks recorded roles and outcomes.
legacy_roster_receipts: Legacy validation and pilot protocol manifests contain the same 20 IDs under test only. The sibling run configuration agrees with each protocol hash. Retained confirmation gates report held_out_test_used false with failed checks. No legacy holdout-start or holdout-outcome record was found.
assessment_receipts: The two designated sensitivity-evaluation fold manifests each contain the same reserved roster for seven image-only policies. These are recorded outcomes from the intended audit.
